steps_completed: 1. BiHBase: literal BH(G) = n * sum over nonzero Laplacian eigenvalues of lambda^{-2}, using mathlib's SimpleGraph.lapMatrix and Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues; proof that a connected graph has exactly one zero eigenvalue (card_zero_eigs_of_connected), so 'sum over nonzero eigenvalues' agrees with 'i = 2..n'; starGraphFin and pathGraphFin with bhStar/bhPath; bh_nonneg.
2. BiHTrace: real spectral theorem A = U diag(lambda) U^T, trace of the inverse and of the inverse squared expressed through eigenvalues, and eigenvector-basis trace formula.
3. BiHBridge: the spectral-to-algebraic bridge BH(G) = n * tr((M')^2) for any factorization L = B B^T with B^T 1 = 0, M = B^T B invertible with inverse M', and ker L consisting of constant vectors.
4. BiHAudit: #print axioms for every main theorem above; the only axioms are propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound.
theorem_statements: BiH.bh (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] : ℝ := (Fintype.card V : ℝ) * ∑ i : V, if lapEigs G i = 0 then 0 else (lapEigs G i)⁻¹ ^ 2
BiH.bh_eq_card_mul_sum_filter (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] : bh G = (Fintype.card V : ℝ) * ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i => lapEigs G i ≠ 0), (lapEigs G i)⁻¹ ^ 2
BiH.bh_nonneg (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] : 0 ≤ bh G
BiH.rank_lapMatrix_eq_card_sub_finrank_ker (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] : (G.lapMatrix ℝ).rank = Fintype.card V - Module.finrank ℝ (LinearMap.ker (Matrix.toLin' (G.lapMatrix ℝ)))
BiH.card_zero_eigs_of_connected (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (hG : G.Connected) : (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : V => lapEigs G i = 0)).card = 1
BiH.card_nonzero_eigs_of_connected (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (hG : G.Connected) : (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : V => lapEigs G i ≠ 0)).card = Fintype.card V - 1
BiH.spectral_real (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (hA : A.IsHermitian) : A = (hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℝ) * diagonal hA.eigenvalues * (hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℝ)ᵀ
BiH.trace_eq_sum_dotProduct_col (A U : Matrix n n ℝ) (hU : Uᵀ * U = 1) (hUU : U * Uᵀ = 1) : A.trace = ∑ j, (fun i => U i j) ⧑ᵛ (A *ᵛ fun i => U i j)

BiH.inv_eq_spectral (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hdet : A.det ≠ 0) : A⁻¹ = (hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℝ) * diagonal (fun i => (hA.eigenvalues i)⁻¹) * star (hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℝ)
BiH.trace_inv_eq_sum_inv (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hdet : A.det ≠ 0) : A⁻¹.trace = ∑ i, (hA.eigenvalues i)⁻¹
BiH.trace_inv_sq_eq_sum_inv_sq (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hdet : A.det ≠ 0) : (A⁻¹ * A⁻¹).trace = ∑ i, ((hA.eigenvalues i)⁻¹) ^ 2

BiH.bh_eq_card_mul_trace_inv_sq [Nonempty V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (B : Matrix V E ℝ) (M M' : Matrix E E ℝ) (hL : G.lapMatrix ℝ = B * Bᵀ) (hM : M = Bᵀ * B) (hMM' : M * M' = 1) (hM'M : M' * M = 1) (hB1 : Bᵀ *ᵛ (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) = 0) (hker : ∀ x : V → ℝ, G.lapMatrix ℝ *ᵛ x = 0 → ∀ i j : V, x i = x j) : bh G = (Fintype.card V : ℝ) * (M' * M').trace
